description: Owns governance, approvals, project setup and Control Core decisions.
Loads source schedules and supports logic, baseline and lookahead quality.
Performs schedule/data quality review and control account analysis.
Analyzes EVM, trends, changes and early warnings across the control cycle.
Captures ERP actuals, commitments, invoices and cost records.
Manages contracts, notices, communications and entitlement evidence.
Manages the controlled document register, transmittals, project mail and review closeout.
Captures physical progress, quantities, resources and field evidence.
Owns AWP package readiness, constraints, IWP release and workface planning.
Supports forensic analysis, causality, impact and evidence packages.
Reads project, portfolio and decision dashboards without transactional rights.
